title: 대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판 / Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition
description:
Éléments de géométrie algébrique — Korean Cumulative Edition (대수기하학 원론 (EGA) — 한국어 누적판), release 2026-08-31-r32.

This independently maintained cumulative reader preserves all Korean EGA material that has passed the project’s source, translation, typesetting, and deterministic QA gates. It contains complete Korean EGA 0_I and EGA I; the complete EGA II Chapter II programme; and a contiguous translation of EGA II §1 through §1.7.12, canonical French source ega2-1-fr.tex lines 1–1193. EGA II and the complete EGA corpus remain incomplete. No claim of corpus completion, finality, infallibility, perfection, or external human certification is made.

The stable edition DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21921513 identifies the evolving Korean EGA lineage. The exact-version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22207983 identifies this immutable r32 checkpoint. The public working repository is github.com/KokunoYumeto/ega-ko. Earlier exact-version records and release directories remain historical checkpoints; Korean FGA and SGA are separate corpus lineages.

The r32 increment translates the complete proposition §1.7.11 with its proof and §1.7.12, canonical lines 1118–1193. The five assertions preserve contravariance of V(E), finite type over the base, the canonical identification V(E⊕F)=V(E)×_S V(F), compatibility with base change, and the closed immersion induced by a surjective module homomorphism. The proof retains its cited symmetric-algebra identities and all morphism directions. The following construction identifies V(O_S) with the affine S-scheme associated with O_S[T], preserves the historical notation and formula S[T]=S⊗_Z Z[T], and recovers the identification of the sheaf of germs of S-sections with O_S. Numbered statements, labels, references and printed-page boundary II 18 remain source-synchronized.

The admitted canonical prefix is 53,487 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 7701EE8E67DFDD0F9C41BF085E6288E15D6C08E7FD1374FDB5A77960708CF718. The new source slice is 3,574 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 9886BF1C9A31B03EA6F5FE98E75A762BD0128B33B81C354B664B2BD1279A3D3E. Its Korean target file is 54,304 bytes, SHA-256 C149B382E1F49565B74C0C2D72FE81F51A8B8D7F1168189BCB3DB6CF7854C47F; the increment is 3,589 LF-terminal UTF-8 bytes, SHA-256 2F66AF037741FADC729FC05A3459B7E89D68EDA43FE26E758D2AE4D6A13D19E2.

The cumulative PDF has 233 pages, 1,451,539 bytes, and SHA-256 46325FFC93EFE7D18DAE08CA79F933601FEEAF97C98ED3E666B8F93ACCF38B8F. The edition retains 222 historical printed-page markers. Release evidence binds editable TeX, the cumulative coverage matrix, source-authority records, terminology decisions, translation-admission controls, reproducible XeLaTeX logs, independent text extractions, replacement-character checks, internal links and named destinations, selected high-resolution visual renders, and SHA-256 inventories. The build fails closed on source identity, input ordering, admitted boundaries, and target hashes. Legacy Type1 mathematics fonts do not provide full ToUnicode mappings: extracted mathematical text is not lossless; editable TeX and rendered formulas remain authoritative. Hard reproducible checks establish only the tested properties and exact bytes; they do not establish perfection. Confirmed defects and documented uncertainties are addressed in later immutable versions.

Historical creators: Alexander Grothendieck and Jean Dieudonné. AI typesetting & translation is the sole standardized project contributor. This independent translation is not endorsed by the historical authors, NUMDAM, IHÉS, source publishers, repositories, or cited third parties.
